plainLanguage: Beaumont is in Jefferson County, one of the Texas coastal counties where the state windstorm program (TDI) applies. To get windstorm insurance (TWIA), the house must be built and inspected to TDI windstorm rules and receive a WPI-8 certificate, which adds engineering and cost. Much of Beaumont is in mapped flood zones; if yours is, the floor must be built above the flood level. Beaumont is Climate Zone 2A (hot-humid). We could not confirm the city's code edition or zoning setbacks in this pass, so the engine uses typical values and asks you to confirm them. The city cannot require brick.
